title: Resonant Link Labels
idiom: Klee-style gouache, a vibrating string between two stones
hero_prompt: Gouache painting on paper in the manner of Paul Klee, flat and graphic with visible brush and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: two small plain grey stones at the far left and far right of the banner, joined by one single taut string that is vibrating, the space between them swelling into a wide shimmering envelope of overlapping wave loops in warm red, gold, rose and deep blue, so all the colour in the picture lives in the link and none in the stones. Soft dark ground.
icon_prompt: Flat gouache emblem, a single-colour black silhouette on a warm gold ground, no shading or gradients: two small solid dots, one at each side, joined by one thick wavy line that swells wide in the middle like a plucked, vibrating string. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
